artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan making an unknown-flag refusal self-record a schema-valid refusal entry into the task's own issues.jsonl and exit with a new distinct code 2, plus regression cases, documentation parity, and a redeploy for non-vacuous default-mode verification.

memory_candidates.content: Two coupled facts govern verifying a source-store script edit in agent-system/extensions/core: (1) a test suite using common_test_resolve_subject with mode deploy-tree-first honours CORE_TEST_SUBJECT_MODE=source-store, so the edited source-store copy CAN be exercised without a redeploy even when the script itself refuses direct source-store invocation via deploy-root-guard.sh (the suite copies it into a scratch .claude/scripts/ mirror); (2) the corollary cost -- the moment that suite gains cases asserting the NEW behaviour, a default-mode run resolves the stale deployed copy and those cases FAIL until a redeploy. A plan touching such a script must therefore schedule the redeploy inside the task (declaring the __WHOLE_TREE__ sentinel in that phase's Files to modify) rather than leaving it to the orchestration close, and must not claim verify-touched.sh as a pre-redeploy covering check: its suites resolve subjects deploy-tree-first and would validate the stale copy.
